main_text.p: ris:nec tu eum monueris,nec fueris dehorta-tus impium à via fua :peribit is quidem in fua iniquitate , fed fanguinem eius de manu tua requiram:hæc ille, quæ vtinam Ecclefiæ mi-niftri attentè audiant & ferio apud fe expen-dant:ne vel ignauia fponte torpeant, vel eo-rum diligentia langueat ingratitudine popu li aut etiã tarditate:vtinam,inquam, audiant ex Iuftino martyre negligentes non effe ne-gligendos. Nec vero vllo modo ferendi funt Negli- quibus moleftũ eft à fuis Paftoribus admone gētes nōri.Præducet,inquiũt,miniftri & pro cocione funt ne-quantũ videbitur,vitia infectetur:me autè vt gligedi.etiã moneat? me reprehedat?me iudicio Dei & eius minis propofitis deterreat? coftet vni Ad Zecuique fui facti ratio, nec de fingulorum mo nam &ribus Paftores inquirant. Nolo meam vitam Serenu.difcutiant,nolo me defixis affiduè oculis per petuò intueantur? Itáne tandem? Ergóne iubes fpeculatorem otiofum & claufis ocu-1. Tim.lis ftertere? Quid quod Paftores Ecclefiæ 3.Ἐπίσκοποι ab infpiciendo & obferuando no minantur? Cur etiam Apoftolus commemo-rat fe non tantum publice, verumetiam per Act.20fingulas domos Ephefios docuiffe & per to-tum triennium nocte & die cum lacrymis vnumquemque monuiffe? Num porrò extra 1.Thess.officij fui fines egreffus eft, cum vnumquèq; 2.Thessalonicensium, tanquam pater liberos hortatus eft atque consolatus?Ecclesiæ mini-ftros cum medicis Paulus comparabat : quis Tit.1.

page.notes: Scan is a single printed page. Notes on the right margin are read in line order and placed at the line where they stand. The note "Negli-gētes nō ... funt ne-gligedi." is one note split over several lines by the printer. Greek word Ἐπίσκοποι is printed in a small, slightly worn form; the reading is likely but the breathing marks may differ. The running head reads PSALM. XXXII. as printed. Some marginal abbreviations (Ad Ze, nam &, Serenu.) are cut short by the printer and may be incomplete.
